name: light-dark
acceptance: dark benches: a measured-dark roofed work cell gets one affordable lamp beside it

name: light-partial
acceptance: partially lit benches: a lit lamp whose radius only grazes the work cell does not stop a lamp of its own

name: light-outage
acceptance: lamp outage: an unpowered lamp in reach holds for the power family instead of doubling up

name: light-fungus
acceptance: protected fungus rooms: a room growing a plant that dies to light is never latched nor lit

name: clean-filthy
acceptance: filthy vs inherently dirty rooms: a filthy kitchen is cleaned, butchery and barn are never latched

name: clean-separation
acceptance: kitchen/butcher separation: a co-located butcher bench is replaced by one outside the kitchen

name: floor-roles
acceptance: role-driven floors: the clean tier floors the kitchen from the measured terrain census

name: routes-unreachable-store
acceptance: unreachable stores: a sealed stockpile is opened by a door on an observed breach wall

name: power-fuel
acceptance: exhausted fuel: an out-of-fuel generator holds for refuel and raises the fuel stock target

name: power-reserve
acceptance: exhausted batteries: reserve runway under one day admits a generator

name: refrigeration-hot-weather
acceptance: hot-weather freezer failure: the cooler cut off from the generator is reconnected by the power family, then set and cooled

name: refrigeration-disconnected
acceptance: disconnected consumers: no cooler at all, one is admitted on a vented wall and measured cooling follows

name: refrigeration-setpoint
acceptance: maintained temperature: a warm freezer is corrected through its cooler setpoint, not a second cooler
